	<ResortReportHeadline>Another fun breezy one.</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It's a breezy start to the day up here, but it is forecast to moderate as the day unfolds. After an overnight low of -1.5, it's currently -1 and the forecast top is 3 degrees. There's a light fog in the Village and the wind is stiff northwesterly.</p><p>With the temps dipping below zero, the snow has had a shallow freeze, but it won't take long to soften as the day warms. The open groomed terrain will be in pretty good shape from the outset offering the best turns.&nbsp;</p><p>Due to the shallow cover, the Village Loop and Heavenly Valley have been upgraded in difficulty. Be sure to observe all signage before getting too adventurous.&nbsp;</p><p>Strong winds will impact lift operations today. Due to winds, we won't be operating WRX First Tracks on Road Runner, with other lifts expected to open from 8:30am.&nbsp;Check in with the App or the Lift Report for live updates.</p><p>Have a great weekend! Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
